facts.fact: Mozambique joined the SADC Regional Working Group on Data Protection through INTIC, with board chair Lourino Chemane appointed effective member and Rosa Dique alternate, after SADC ICT ministers urged states to appoint representatives.

facts.fact: SADC ministers responsible for ICT met on 26 June 2026 in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe, and urged member states to appoint representatives to the Regional Working Group on Data Protection.
